+func TestLoadWithoutPath(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Run("uses defaults when relevant environment variables are unset", func(t *testing.T) {
+		t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "")
+		t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "")
+		require.NoError(t, os.Unsetenv("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL"))
+		require.NoError(t, os.Unsetenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT"))
+
+		res, err := Load("")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, Default().Log.Level, res.Config.Log.Level)
+		assert.Equal(t, Default().Server.HTTPPort, res.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("applies environment overrides to defaults", func(t *testing.T) {
+		t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "debug")

+
+		res, err := Load("")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
